Langley condos and townhomes: sale price, days on market and sale-to-list, May to September 2026
In September 2026 condos and townhomes in Langley sold about 3% below list price, after 25 days on market on the reports’ measure (down from 26 in May).

blocks.text: Langley condos and townhomes: 13 months of listings, sales and prices to September 2026

Over the 13 months from September 2025 to September 2026, listings of condos and townhomes in Langley peaked at 899 in September 2025 and bottomed at 561 in December 2025. Sales were strongest in April 2026 with 159. The reported sale price moved from $675,000 to $611,000, a change of −9.5%.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
